For Readers

Your morning paper, reimagined

Everything you need to manage your newspaper and magazine subscriptions — transparent billing, instant controls, and a relationship with your agent built on trust. Best of all? It's completely free for readers.

01

One-Tap Payments

Pay your newspaper bill instantly. No more chasing your delivery agent for receipts or fumbling with cash.

02

Pause & Resume

Going on vacation? Pause delivery with a single tap and resume when you return. Your agent gets notified automatically.

03

Smart Notifications

Get timely reminders for billing, delivery changes, subscription renewals, and everything in between.

04

Full Transparency

See exactly what you're paying for — itemized bills, delivery history, price breakdowns, all in one place.

Process

Three steps to modern delivery

01

Register

— Set up in minutes

Create your agent account. Define your delivery region, add publications, and set pricing — all through a guided setup.

02

Onboard

— Add your customers

Add customers via the app. They receive a digital confirmation link, review their subscription details, and confirm with one tap.

03

Deliver & Grow

— Focus on what matters

Deliver as usual. Pathrika handles billing, payment reminders, collections, and analytics. You focus on growing your business.

Pricing

Transparent Pricing for Agents

No fixed monthly contracts. No setup fees. You only pay a micro-fee when you successfully record or collect money.

100% Free for Readers
The Doorstep Route

Cash Ledger

For agents managing doorstep cash collections with Pathrika Credits.

₹3/ recorded bill
Pay-as-you-go billing
  • Automatically generate digital monthly bills
  • Share secure bill links with customers
  • Track cash collections with clear audit visibility
  • Support customer vacation hold requests
  • Downloadable PDF bills with payment confirmation notifications
  • Access subscription analytics across your customer base
Most Popular
The Automated Route

Smart Collect

Automated UPI collections with direct bank settlements.

₹6/ recorded bill
Includes payment gateway fees
  • Everything in Cash Ledger, plus:
  • Automated bill reminders
  • One-click UPI payments
  • No door-to-door payment collection required
  • Save 50+ operational hours each month
  • Save ₹1,000+ on monthly fuel costs
  • Direct bank settlements
  • Automated late fee handling
  • End-to-end bill status tracking

Offline
